insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation in the GraphQL Admin API now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. This is achieved through the addition of a trackingNumbers field to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput. The change allows for more accurate and detailed order tracking.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field for more precise tracking. This change does not break existing functionality but enhances it. Developers should review their order creation processes to ensure they are taking advantage of this new feature. The GraphQL Admin API will continue to support previous versions, but it is recommended to update to the latest version to access new features.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, potentially improving customer satisfaction and reducing support queries related to order tracking.
insight.why_it_matters: This update matters because it enhances the functionality of the orderCreate mutation, allowing for more detailed tracking information. This can lead to improved customer experiences and more efficient order management for merchants.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have also been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Upcoming Changes and Requirements
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and updating an order's shipping address will recalculate taxes as of August 31, 2026. Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have also been updated.
